headline: Liberia Mandates Domestic Gold Refining and Plans Sovereign Wealth Fund
summary: President Joseph Nyuma Boakai announced Liberia will require gold to be refined domestically before export. The government also plans a sovereign wealth fund and a state-owned mining company that will take project equity stakes.
why: Resource-rich developing nations adjust mining codes to retain processing value domestically and capture direct state equity returns from mineral assets.

impacts.name: Liberia
impacts.why: Mandatory domestic refining and direct state equity stakes can raise local fiscal revenues but increase capital requirements for mining operators.
